AUTOMATIC NOTIFICATIONS
THE RIGHT UPDATE.
THE RIGHT CHANNEL.
Saved contacts. Approved documents. Automatic delivery.
WhatsApp & Gmail
There is no recipient list to enter for every report. Save donor contacts with a donation once; future reports use that directory automatically.
WhatsApp is used when a saved number is available; otherwise Gmail is used. Review and approval remain required before a report or receipt is sent.
Record a donation →
Automatic notifications
Approved reports go to saved donors. Approved donations trigger a receipt PDF and thank-you. Monthly inactivity alerts go to your saved coordinator.
Configure coordinator access once in Records. Donor contacts are saved from donation entries.

ABOUT NGO REPORTS & RECEIPTS
YOUR WORK.
CLEARLY REPORTED.
A focused reporting workspace for small NGOs and community organisations.
From field notes to donor updates
Bring activities, participation figures, challenges and next steps together in one report. Spend less effort arranging information and more time reviewing what matters.
Your facts stay central
AI-assisted drafts link statements to your original notes. Review every claim and figure before approving the report.
You approve the final version
Edit the draft, preview the formatted report and approve it, then save a record or export a copy. Changes to the report require a fresh approval.
Use it where you work
Open the workspace on a computer or phone, or add it to your home screen. Save approved reports to Records or download a copy. Unsaved changes are not retained.
